finish.summary: Three-high single-cell tower (0,0 levels 0-2) with a drop-in bin on top and 3-compartment bolt-on bins on levels 0 and 1, capped and locked, staged with tumbler/spoon props. No spice-jar props exist so staging is representative only.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

jointBolt.note: A joint bolt fastens the wall between two touching bases. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

connector.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups.
